ABOUT THE PRACTICE

A professional perspective shaped by service.

Rakesh Puri & Associates combines legal advocacy with decades of experience in policing and criminal investigation.

THE PRACTICE

Law. Investigation. Experience.

Rakesh Kumar Puri is an advocate practising in Rajasthan. His professional background spans 35 years of police service and legal practice focused on criminal litigation and constitutional writ matters.

During police service, he held SHO and Circle Officer postings across Rajasthan and served as Additional Superintendent of Police with JDVVNL in Jodhpur and the Anti-Terrorist Squad in Jodhpur. His highest rank was Additional Superintendent of Police.

That experience provides a practical understanding of investigation records, witness accounts, forensic evidence and criminal procedure. In advocacy, those disciplines support careful case preparation and focused courtroom work.

PROFESSIONAL FOUNDATIONS

Experience across two disciplines.

01 / SERVICE

Police service

Thirty-five years of service, including field policing, SHO and Circle Officer postings, and Additional SP roles in Jodhpur.

02 / PRACTICE

Legal advocacy

Criminal law, constitutional writ matters, trial advocacy and evidence-focused case preparation.

PRACTICE AREA / 01

Criminal law.

Representation in criminal proceedings informed by an extensive background in investigation, evidence and procedure.

SCOPE OF WORK

From first records to final arguments.

Criminal matters call for close attention to the investigation record, the legal elements of an offence and the evidence that can properly be placed before a court.

The practice includes trials, bail and anticipatory bail, appeals, revisions, quashing petitions and related criminal proceedings. Each matter is assessed on its own facts and the applicable law.

01

Pre-trial & bail

Bail and anticipatory bail, charge-sheet review, discharge and charge framing.

02

Trial advocacy

Witness examination, cross-examination, evidentiary objections and final arguments.

03

Appellate work

Appeals, revisions, quashing and related proceedings.

QUESTIONS OF EVIDENCE

Investigation knowledge in legal practice.

Experience with documentary and electronic records, forensic and medical material, witness credibility and circumstantial evidence informs a methodical approach to criminal litigation.

/practice-areas/writ-jurisdiction/.content:
Home/Practice AreasWrit Jurisdiction

PRACTICE AREA / 02

Constitutional & writ jurisdiction.

Representation in writ matters where public power, legal duty and individual rights are in issue.

WRIT REMEDIES

A focused route to judicial review.

Writ jurisdiction provides constitutional remedies in appropriate cases. The relief available depends on the facts, the forum and applicable law.

The practice includes matters concerning habeas corpus, mandamus, certiorari, prohibition and quo warranto. Each proposed petition requires a careful assessment of maintainability, records and available relief.

01Habeas Corpus
02Mandamus
03Certiorari
04Prohibition
05Quo Warranto

WORKING METHOD

Records, questions and relief.

A writ matter begins with a careful review of the factual timeline, the decision or action in question, and the relief sought.

01

Initial record

Orders, correspondence and the sequence of relevant events.

02

Legal issue

The public duty, decision or jurisdiction being questioned.

03

Forum

Whether the proposed proceeding belongs in writ jurisdiction requires matter-specific assessment.

04

Relief

The remedy requested must follow from the facts and applicable law.

Privacy policy.

Information you provide

Home/Professional Profile

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

Rakesh Kumar Puri.

Advocate, Rajasthan. A professional journey spanning police service, investigation and courtroom advocacy.

RKPRAKESH KUMAR PURI · ADVOCATE

BIOGRAPHY

Experience earned in the field. Applied at the bar.

Rakesh Kumar Puri served in the police for 35 years and attained the rank of Additional Superintendent of Police. His postings included Station House Officer and Circle Officer roles across Rajasthan, Additional SP with JDVVNL in Jodhpur and Additional SP with the Anti-Terrorist Squad in Jodhpur.

He is an advocate whose primary focus is criminal law and constitutional writ matters. His background is especially relevant to investigation-record analysis, witness and forensic evidence, trial preparation and criminal procedure.

PROFESSIONAL JOURNEY

From service to advocacy.

01

Police service — 35 years

Field policing, SHO and Circle Officer postings across Rajasthan.

02

Additional Superintendent of Police

JDVVNL, Jodhpur and Anti-Terrorist Squad, Jodhpur.

03

Legal practice

Criminal litigation, constitutional writ matters, trial advocacy and evidence analysis.

EDUCATION & KNOWLEDGE

Teaching and continued professional engagement.

B.Com., LL.B.

Jai Narain Vyas University, Jodhpur.

Knowledge & training

Professional lectures and training have addressed forensics, medical jurisprudence, women’s safety, police administration, social awareness and the criminal justice system.
